```{r readout phenotype txt file}

TCGA_GBM_pheno

```

```{r}
df <-   merge(
  TCGA_GBM_expression,
  TCGA_GBM_pheno[, c("Sample", "Subtype")],
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE
)
df <- df %>%
  relocate(Sample, Subtype, .before = 1)
df_naomit <- na.omit(df)
row.names(df_naomit) <- df_naomit$Sample
df_naomit
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Remove Sample + Subtype columns to get expression matrix
expr_only <- df_naomit[ , !(names(df_naomit) %in% c("Sample", "Subtype"))]

# Compute average per gene within each subtype
gene_means_by_subtype <- df_naomit %>%
  group_by(Subtype) %>%
  summarise(across(-Sample, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Example: top 10 per subtype
top_genes <- gene_means_by_subtype %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Subtype, names_to = "gene", values_to = "mean_expr") %>%
  group_by(Subtype) %>%
  slice_max(mean_expr, n = 50)
top_genes
```


```{r}
top_genes_Proneural <- top_genes %>%
  filter(Subtype == "Proneural") %>%
  pull(gene)
top_genes_Proneural
```

```{r}
top_genes_Classical <- top_genes %>%
  filter(Subtype == "Classical") %>%
  pull(gene)
top_genes_Classical
```

```{r}
top_genes_Mesenchymal <- top_genes %>%
  filter(Subtype == "Mesenchymal") %>%
  pull(gene)
top_genes_Mesenchymal
```


```{r, fig.height=10}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(top_genes, aes(x = reorder(gene, mean_expr), y = mean_expr, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~Subtype, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 50 Highly Expressed Genes per Subtype",
       x = "Gene",
       y = "Mean Expression")

```

###########################################################
# Analyze the gene expression of each gene within each subtype
###########################################################
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
gene_means_by_subtype <- df_naomit %>%
  group_by(Subtype) %>%
  summarise(across(-Sample, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))
gene_means_by_subtype[1:5, 1:6]  # show first few rows/genes
```

```{r}
long_expr <- df_naomit %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Sample, Subtype), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Expression")
long_expr
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
my_comparisons <- list(c("Proneural", "Classical"), 
                       c("Proneural", "Mesenchymal"), 
                       c("Classical", "Mesenchymal"))
gene <- "SOX10"
long_expr %>%
  filter(Gene == gene) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Subtype, y = Expression, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Subtype), width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste0("Expression of ", gene," across Subtypes")) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = my_comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",    # pairwise non-parametric test
    label = "p.signif"
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# differential expression analysis between subtypes
```{r}
library(limma)
library(dplyr)

# Expression matrix: genes in rows, samples in columns
expr_mat <- df_naomit %>%
  dplyr::select(-Sample, -Subtype) %>%
  t()  # transpose so rows = genes, columns = samples

rownames(expr_mat) <- colnames(df_naomit)[-(1:2)]  # gene names
colnames(expr_mat) <- df_naomit$Sample

# Create design matrix for subtypes
subtypes <- df_naomit$Subtype
design <- model.matrix(~0 + subtypes)
colnames(design) <- levels(factor(subtypes))

# Fit model
fit <- lmFit(expr_mat, design)

# Define contrasts (example: Proneural vs Classical, Proneural vs Mesenchymal, Classical vs Mesenchymal)
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Proneural_vs_Classical = Proneural - Classical,
  Proneural_vs_Mesenchymal = Proneural - Mesenchymal,
  Classical_vs_Mesenchymal = Classical - Mesenchymal,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# Example: Proneural vs Classical
top_genes_PC <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Proneural_vs_Classical", number = 100, adjust.method = "BH")
top_genes_PM <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Proneural_vs_Mesenchymal", number = 100, adjust.method = "BH")
top_genes_CM <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Classical_vs_Mesenchymal", number = 100, adjust.method = "BH")
top_genes_PC


# Columns include:
# logFC   : log2 fold-change
# AveExpr : average expression
# t       : moderated t-statistic
# P.Value : raw p-value
# adj.P.Val : BH-adjusted p-value
```

```{r}
# Define one-vs-rest contrasts
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Proneural_vs_Rest = Proneural - (Classical + Mesenchymal)/2,
  Classical_vs_Rest = Classical - (Proneural + Mesenchymal)/2,
  Mesenchymal_vs_Rest = Mesenchymal - (Proneural + Classical)/2,
  levels = design
)
fit <- lmFit(expr_mat, design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
# Proneural vs rest
top_genes_proneural <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Proneural_vs_Rest", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
# Classical vs rest
top_genes_classical <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Classical_vs_Rest", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
# Mesenchymal vs rest
top_genes_mesenchymal <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Mesenchymal_vs_Rest", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
```

```{r}
sig_proneural <- top_genes_proneural %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0)
sig_proneural
```

# subtype prediction for an external sample
##########################
```{r}
library(dplyr)
# Compute mean expression per gene per subtype
ref_profiles <- df_naomit %>%
  group_by(Subtype) %>%
  summarise(across(-Sample, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Subtype")
ref_profiles
# Result: rows = Subtypes (PN, CL, MES), columns = genes
```

## External Profile
```{r}
df_SubtypeME <- read.csv("D:/AG_Tuoc/Projects/2024-02-01_Glioblastoma/Analysis/mGlio_max/Mouse_Singlet_2025-09-09/wsnn_res.2/df_SubtypeME_2025-08-10.csv")
head(df_SubtypeME)
df_external <- df_SubtypeME
#df_external$Sample <- gsub("^avg_log2FC_", "", df_external$X)
row.names(df_external) <- df_external$Sample
colnames(df_external) <- toupper(colnames(df_external))
# Check
head(df_external)
```

```{r}
common_genes <- intersect(colnames(ref_profiles), colnames(df_external))

ref_profiles_sub <- ref_profiles[, common_genes]

ext_samples_sub <- df_external[, common_genes, drop = FALSE]

pred_results <- data.frame(Sample = rownames(ext_samples_sub), 
                           Proneural = NA, Classical = NA, Mesenchymal = NA, 
                           Predicted = NA)

for(i in 1:nrow(ext_samples_sub)) {
  sample_expr <- as.numeric(ext_samples_sub[i, ])
  
  # Compute Spearman correlation
  cor_scores <- apply(ref_profiles_sub, 1, function(x) cor(x, sample_expr, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
  
    pred_results[i, names(cor_scores)] <- cor_scores
  pred_results$Predicted[i] <-  names(which.max(cor_scores))
}
pred_results
```


```{r}
pred_results_norm <- pred_results
pred_results_norm[, 2:4] <- (pred_results[, 2:4] - min(pred_results[, 2:4])) /
                            (max(pred_results[, 2:4]) - min(pred_results[, 2:4]))
pred_results_norm

```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)

# Remove the Predicted column for heatmap
heatmap_mat <- pred_results_norm %>%
  dplyr::select(Proneural, Classical, Mesenchymal) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Set row names as Sample
rownames(heatmap_mat) <- pred_results_norm$Sample
# Create a data frame for row annotation
annotation <- data.frame(Predicted = pred_results_norm$Predicted)
rownames(annotation) <- pred_results_norm$Sample

# Row-wise scaling: (x - mean) / sd
heatmap_scaled <- t(apply(heatmap_mat, 1, function(x) (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)))


# Define colors for predicted subtypes
ann_colors <- list(Predicted = c(
  Proneural = "#00BA38",
  Classical = "#619CFF",
  Mesenchymal = "#F8766D"
))

heatmap_plot <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_scaled,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,        # cluster samples
  cluster_cols = FALSE,       # keep subtypes order fixed
  annotation_row = annotation,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  display_numbers = F,     # show correlation values on cells
  fontsize_number = 10,
  #color = colorRampPalette(c("lightblue", "tomato"))(50),
  main = "Correlation of External Samples with GBM Subtypes"
)
heatmap_plot
```
